cases.customer_question: Can a qualification proceed when including an existing Host Stack and Controller design causes Bluetooth SIG consistency check invalids due to inter-layer dependency issues?
question_variants: Consistency check failed after including existing QDIDs
Host Stack include causes core invalids
Can TCW be used for inter-layer dependency invalids?
Qualification Workspace shows Host Stack consistency check errors
Can I qualify a design that inherits Host and Controller subsystems but adds profiles?
cases.actual_issue: Including previously qualified Host and Controller subsystem designs produced core-layer consistency check invalids related to inter-layer dependencies, creating uncertainty about whether the qualification path remained valid.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The product reused existing Bluetooth qualified designs instead of creating everything from scratch. When those designs were combined and new profile functionality was added, Qualification Workspace reported invalid configuration relationships. The key question was whether the invalids required redesign or could be handled through an approved Bluetooth SIG waiver process.
cases.consultant_answer: The invalids were determined to be associated with inherited Host Stack qualification data rather than a newly introduced implementation defect. A specific Test Case Waiver for X2Core-only additions to existing Host and Controller configurations was identified as applicable. The consultant concluded that the qualification could continue by including the existing qualified designs and using the waiver to address the resulting core-layer invalids, provided the underlying referenced designs were not modified.
cases.decision_logic: If existing qualified Host and Controller configurations are reused without modification and only X2Core/profile functionality is added, an applicable TCW can be used to waive qualifying consistency check invalids generated by inter-layer dependency rules.
cases.final_recommendation: Proceed with the qualification using the existing qualified Host and Controller designs, apply the applicable TCW for the core invalids, and submit the qualification package with the waiver and supporting evidence.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: The qualification may be incorrectly abandoned, delayed, or rejected if consistency check invalids are treated as unresolvable when a valid waiver path exists. Unnecessary redesign or retesting effort may also be incurred.
